payout_quote: Enjoy Up To a $500 Bonus... Earn $300: 1. Open a new account 2. Enroll in online banking & e-statements 3. Have $500+ in direct deposits each month of the Qualification Period OR Earn $500: $2,000+ in direct deposits each month of the Qualification Period... To qualify for a $300 bonus payment, you must (i) Mention offer during in-branch account opening, visit URL provided, or enter Builder when applying online; (ii) have direct deposits totaling at least $500 or more to your new account each month for the 2 consecutive calendar months after the calendar month your new account was opened; & (iii) enroll in online banking & e-statements within the Qualification Period. (Official Wintrust site, crawled 2026-09-23)
timing: Bonus deposited into the new account within 30 calendar days after the Qualification Period (2 consecutive calendar months after account-opening month)
eligibility: New personal checking customers only (no existing or closed Wintrust personal checking); limit 1 bonus per customer; offer valid for eligible accounts opened 5/13/26 - 11/3/26
steps: Open a new Total Access Checking account (mention offer in branch, use the URL, or enter promo code 'Builder' online)
Enroll in online banking and activate e-statements within the Qualification Period
Set up direct deposits totaling $500+/month ($300 tier) or $2,000+/month ($500 tier) for the 2 consecutive calendar months after your account-opening month
Keep the account open with balance above $0 through the Qualification Period
Bonus posts within 30 calendar days after the Qualification Period
catches: TIME-BOUND: offer valid for accounts opened 5/13/26 - 11/3/26
Direct deposit means employer/government/3rd-party electronic deposit - NOT Zelle, Venmo, bank-to-bank transfers, mobile deposits, or wires
You must hit the deposit threshold in EACH of the 2 consecutive months - one short month disqualifies you
Must mention the offer / enter 'Builder' code at opening - no retroactive credit
Existing or former Wintrust checking customers are ineligible
Account must be open with balance > $0 at end of Qualification Period
biggest_catch: The direct-deposit definition is strict - Zelle, Venmo, and transfers from your own other bank accounts do NOT count. Only real payroll/government/benefit deposits qualify.

maximize: Choose your tier honestly: if your paycheck is $2,000+/month, go for the $500 tier - same effort, $200 more. Enroll in online banking and e-statements the same day you open - people lose this bonus by forgetting that step.
